description:
Charming 3-Bedroom Bungalow in a Peaceful Rural Setting

Set in the peaceful countryside of Ballycoog, South Wicklow, this charming 3-bedroom bungalow offers a comfortable and homely living space surrounded by nature.

The property extends to approximately 78 m² and features a bright living room, a separate kitchen, and two double bedrooms. The third room is currently used as an office but could easily be converted into a single bedroom, offering flexibility depending on your needs.

Outside, the property has plenty to offer, including a large deck area, two powered sheds, ample parking, and a colourful, well-established garden with plenty of outdoor space to enjoy.

The house has its own private well and septic system and is heated by an oil-fired central heating system.

A lovely opportunity for anyone looking for a quieter pace of life, this home offers the privacy and space of a rural setting while still being within easy reach of Arklow and the beautiful South Wicklow countryside.
